scripts.setup: npm run setup:api && npm run setup:web
scripts.setup:api: cd API && python3.12 -m venv venv && venv/bin/pip install -U pip && venv/bin/pip install -e '.[dev]'
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.lint:api: cd API && venv/bin/ruff check app tests
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:web
scripts.format:check: cd API && venv/bin/ruff format --check app tests
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:arch && npm --prefix Web run typecheck
